catalog_owns: category strategy and lifecycle decision record
authority_boundary.cross_domain_access: approved orchestration request plus read-only evidence/readback only

idempotency_policy.version_policy: Every decision cites the authoritative category/strategy version and preserves the previous decision record.
idempotency_policy.outbox_policy: A future Catalog implementation must persist the approved transition and its versioned Outbox event in one transaction; this definition does not claim that capability exists.

state_machine.failure_rule: Missing, stale, contradictory, or unauthorized evidence leaves the case in its current non-terminal state; no AI output may create a business conclusion.

steps.downstream_handoff: None; this gate establishes the Catalog-owned scope only.

required_inputs: read-only demand, supply, quality, listing, inventory and promotion evidence
steps.downstream_handoff: An approved opportunity brief may be supplied to assortment planning; it does not change any other domain fact.

steps.responsible: category-manager with assortment manager and commercial approver
steps.downstream_handoff: Creates an approved, versioned request for cloudmold-assortment-planning-lifecycle; it does not create or approve a wave itself.

required_inputs: merchant, assortment, listing, inventory, promotion, quality and supply-chain handoff proposals
steps.downstream_handoff: Each recipient must execute only through its own controlled capability; Catalog neither writes nor infers the resulting records.

required_inputs: read-only domain status and metric snapshots
steps.downstream_handoff: Read-only monitoring only; operational remediation remains with the owning domain.
The review may propose upgrade, maintain, downgrade, remediation, or exit; it cannot enact any of them automatically.
Merchant, assortment, listing, inventory, promotion, quality and supply-chain remediation is requested through their respective governed flows and later read back.
Publishes only the Catalog category strategy decision for controlled downstream consumption; entitlement, listing, inventory and promotion changes remain external requests.

steps.responsible: authorized category approver with risk/compliance reviewer
steps.downstream_handoff: Requests controlled withdrawal or restriction from the owning domains; only their readbacks can confirm completion.

readback_requirement: No runnable category-management query is registered. For local/test/demo, the operator records a read-only evidence bundle and verifies that every handoff reference resolves in its owning domain; production execution is out of scope.
